claim_text: He points to Australia's oil refinery burning, leaving the country down to two active refineries, as the fulfilment of the word to pray over refineries, and says it is similar to what he saw for Tuttle and the Gold Coast.
quote: All of Australia's oil refinery is burning
falsify_match: The earlier word naming Australia before the fire.
falsify_miss: The earlier word names American refineries and Tuttle; Australia is added here after the event. Australia had already been down to two refineries since 2021 for commercial reasons.

claim_text: He points to a report that the Pentagon is ramping up plans for Cuba in case the order comes, as the fulfilment of horns he heard two days earlier and the word that it is time to liberate Cuba, and says the Cuban leader has a double.
quote: it's time to liberate Cuba
falsify_match: An American operation against Cuba following the reported planning.
falsify_miss: No operation. Contingency planning is what a defence department does continuously, which is the base rate here.

claim_text: The Cuban leader leaving the island with stacks of hundred dollar bills on a boat, flying from Cuba to the Dominican Republic in a Gulfstream and on to Mexico, with Claudia seen taking care of him.
quote: I saw him leave in a with stacks of hundred-dollar bills
falsify_match: The Cuban president fleeing to the Dominican Republic and then Mexico.
falsify_miss: He stays. Naming the route and the Mexican president who receives him makes this one of the more specific political claims in the corpus.

claim_text: A cobra slithering on the land of Cuba and a massive sandalled foot with a hole in it coming out of heaven and crushing the snake's head, with the glory rising over Cuba, seen the same night as the Coachella material.
quote: a massive foot came out of heaven, and it looked like a sandal
falsify_match: The Cuban government falling with a religious opening following.
falsify_miss: It holds. The foot with the hole identifies the figure as Christ, which makes this emblematic rather than a described event.

claim_text: The same cobra and foot repeated, with the Coachella night given again as when it was received.
quote: I said, I see a massive foot coming out of heaven
falsify_match: As above.
falsify_miss: As above; repetition within the stream.

claim_text: He points to a new gas pipeline being broken ground on in New York City as the fulfilment of drill baby drill and the word that gas and oil lines would be opened all over America with a major economic boom, and repeats that refineries are a target for drones carrying C4.
quote: He's going to open up gas lines all over America
falsify_match: A sustained pipeline construction programme with a measurable energy boom.
falsify_miss: Construction stays at the normal rate. The Constitution pipeline revival had been under public discussion since 2025.

claim_text: Sabotage seen against pipelines, with the president described as a builder who wants pipelines across America, and a remark that they heard it by the spirit before Fox News reported it.
quote: We heard it first by the spirit of the Lord
falsify_match: An earlier recording naming pipelines before the announcement.
falsify_miss: Drill baby drill has been administration policy since 2024, so the direction was public throughout.

claim_text: He says he was taken to a meeting with computer screens and blueprints, allowed to zoom in on mathematical equations fed into AI, which said the asteroid will not miss Earth and will hit, while the people there talked themselves out of it.
quote: AI said, This is not going to miss Earth. It's going to hit
falsify_match: A published impact assessment concluding a strike is certain.
falsify_miss: No such assessment. Impact probabilities are published openly and revised as observation arcs lengthen, which is the opposite of concealment.

claim_text: Four Chinese scientists heard in panic planning to run a rocket into the side of an asteroid to push it off course, with practice runs promised, and he is told the Chinese are more convinced than the Americans while the Americans say it might still miss.
quote: The Chinese are more convinced than the Americans
falsify_match: A divergence between Chinese and American impact assessments becoming public.
falsify_miss: No divergence. China's announced deflection demonstration mission was already public reporting, which he shows on screen in the same breath.

claim_text: The same meeting described again, with the scientists freaking out over how to stop it hitting, and the Chinese mission to strike an asteroid shown on screen as confirmation.
quote: I was in the meeting. The Lord allowed me to go
falsify_match: As above.
falsify_miss: As above; the confirmation is a published mission plan rather than a hidden one.

claim_text: A meeting with bankers on one side and crypto people on the other in which the banks fight against crypto getting clarity, with Chase holding a rocket down by a lasso together with Bank of America and Wells Fargo, and BlackRock in the distance, because they did not want to lose what they had.
quote: They were holding the rocket down and they had a lasso around it
falsify_match: Those banks lobbying against crypto market structure legislation and then reversing.
falsify_miss: They support it throughout. Several of the named banks had already announced crypto custody and stablecoin plans before this, which cuts against the picture.

claim_text: An event after which JD Vance comes on the scene, with Erica Kirk consoling America out of her own experience of losing her husband and acting as a spokesperson because Usha was not there, and a polished man rising up beside her to help.
quote: I saw J.D. Vance come on the scene
falsify_match: A presidential succession in which Vance takes over and Erica Kirk becomes a public consoling figure.
falsify_miss: No succession. Usha being absent is the detail that makes this a claim about a marriage as well as a presidency.

claim_text: Groups with homemade explosives set up in bases across the nation, Texas seceding and becoming its own country with walls dividing it from Louisiana and Mexico, Oklahoma joining Texas as friends, crops and homemade gardens, and the book One Second After recommended.
quote: I saw Texas secede secede from the nation
falsify_match: Texas leaving the union with Oklahoma attached.
falsify_miss: No secession. One Second After is an EMP survival novel, which is where the scenario in this passage comes from.

claim_text: A device sent up over the Mississippi and fired over Kentucky and Tennessee that did not get high enough, so that Oklahoma, Texas and parts of Florida were spared while the east was badly affected, and he asks whether he is looking into the tribulation.
quote: But, it didn't get high enough
falsify_match: A high altitude detonation over the American midsouth with a regional rather than national effect.
falsify_miss: No such event. The partial footprint is the specific part: a lower burst gives a smaller radius, which is physically consistent.

claim_text: In the same scene he saw veterans rather than FBI, CIA or NSA protecting the country, and explains that he holds things back because of critics, saying it is not his responsibility to spoon-feed people.
quote: I saw veterans. Why?
falsify_match: Federal agencies absent and veterans organised in their place during a crisis.
falsify_miss: No such crisis. He notes the absence himself and cannot explain it, which is worth recording.

claim_text: He is told there will be no one to save America other than God, and that the church did not idolise Obama the way it now idolises this president, with Hagin and Wigglesworth cited that a man is usually removed the moment people look to him as the saviour.
quote: There will be no one save America other than me
falsify_match: The president being removed after the church exalts him.
falsify_miss: He serves out his term. The removal-follows-idolatry rule is stated as a general principle, which makes it applicable either way.

claim_text: He says the flattery has to stop, that only Jesus will save America, that a door of pride has been opened, and that a great shaking to awaken follows.
quote: There's been a door of pride that has been opened
falsify_match: A reversal for the figure being exalted.
falsify_miss: No reversal. The door of pride framing means any later difficulty can be read as its consequence.

claim_text: He says it is not easy to say these things, that America will be humbled in the days ahead, and that it is not a popular message but he saw the shaking.
quote: America will be humbled in the days ahead
falsify_match: A national reversal recognisable as a humbling.
falsify_miss: Conditions hold. Humbled is not defined, which leaves the threshold open.

claim_text: Corruption on both sides with a bill in California proposing a ten thousand dollar fine for exposing it, a young YouTuber doing the exposing rather than politicians, and repeated warnings that he has seen the young man taken out by a deranged person, more violent than the Kirk killing.
quote: I've seen it more than once now him being being taken out
falsify_match: An attack on the named investigator.
falsify_miss: No attack. Seen more than once and compared to a recent killing makes this a specific and unusually direct warning about a living private individual.

claim_text: Prayer that Mike Lindell win Minnesota by a landslide and that other godly candidates win, with corruption in Minnesota, California, Texas, Nevada and Mexico exposed and cleaned up.
quote: pray for Mike Lindell to win by a landslide
falsify_match: Lindell winning a Minnesota race by a large margin.
falsify_miss: He loses or does not run. Minnesota has not elected a Republican to statewide office since 2006, which is the base rate against it.

claim_text: Prayer that embezzlement of taxpayer dollars be brought to light and that the war in Iran be finished and not long lasting, with the president described as having a backbone like a crowbar.
quote: we finished the the war in Iran
falsify_match: A short conclusion to the Iran campaign.
falsify_miss: It drags on. Framed as a petition, but the short-war expectation is stated.

claim_text: Cuba seen falling within a day, with the task finished and the man used to bring liberty across the land.
quote: Cuba. It falls within a day
falsify_match: The Cuban government collapsing within twenty four hours of an operation.
falsify_miss: It does not fall, or falls slowly. A single day is a hard bound and one of the sharpest timing claims in the corpus.

claim_text: A passage largely in tongues around Cuba and the Cold War, with the repeated statement that it is from Russia and that there are things there from the Cold War that people do not know.
quote: It's from Russia. There's things there that you do not
falsify_match: Soviet-era material found in Cuba.
falsify_miss: None found. Most of this passage is glossolalia with the English fragments carrying the claim.

claim_text: The Cold War item from Russia identified as a secret thing and then as a briefcase, which the Cuban leader wants to use.
quote: It's a secret thing. It's a briefcase
falsify_match: A portable Soviet device found in Cuban hands.
falsify_miss: None. Suitcase nuclear devices are a persistent claim with no verified example ever produced.

claim_text: The briefcase located under a mountain in a fortified bunker with an entrance on the mountainside facing towards America.
quote: It's the side facing towards America
falsify_match: A bunker of that description found in Cuba.
falsify_miss: None found. The side facing America is the locating detail, which is checkable if a site is ever named.

claim_text: Miami and the mules recalled, with the purple faced dragon that came up out of the water at Havana three times in the middle of the night carrying a canister.
quote: Three times the dragon came up out of the water out of Havana
falsify_match: Three night deliveries of a container from Havana.
falsify_miss: None. Three times is the countable detail on an otherwise emblematic image.

claim_text: He repeats that Cuba cannot strap a payload onto anything and has nothing like Iran's rockets, that what they have is nothing, but that the old man's Cold War item makes the leader braver, and prayer is asked for Rubio and the bronze hands.
quote: they're not half what Iran has
falsify_match: Cuban strike capability demonstrated.
falsify_miss: None exists. He holds both that Cuba cannot strike America and that it has a hidden Cold War weapon, which are in tension.

claim_text: A storm seen again over Boston and New York with many 9/11s, and something trying to happen there.
quote: Over Boston, New York, I see a storm. Many many 9/11s
falsify_match: Multiple simultaneous attacks in those two cities.
falsify_miss: No attacks. Many small 9/11s is a phrase he has used since 2024 without a location; here it is fixed to two cities.

claim_text: A demonic entity standing as a shadow up by New York gaining strength from the blood of the innocent through abortion, with more developed foetuses giving it more strength.
quote: it would give this demonic entity strength from the blood
falsify_match: Not checkable as an event.
falsify_miss: Not checkable. This is the same bull image given three days later with the nose ring.

claim_text: A pyramid or triangle stronghold built through the upright demonic bull, with celebrities and politicians of great power paid off by positions in the spirit realm, seen while praying over the Save America Act and what was blocking it.
quote: certain people with great power were paid off by demonic things
falsify_match: Named figures exposed as having taken payments to block the legislation.
falsify_miss: No such exposure. Paid off by positions in the spirit realm is not a transaction that could be documented.

claim_text: The figures wearing masquerade masks so their faces could not be seen, some in purple and black, performing satanic practices to prepare an antichrist spirit to destroy America, and the word that only an awakening will save America rather than the Save America Act.
quote: the only thing that will save America is an awakening
falsify_match: The legislation passing and making no difference.
falsify_miss: Not checkable as stated, since an awakening is not measurable, and the condition means failure is attributed to its absence.

claim_text: Abortion framed as a moral issue of promiscuity outside marriage rather than a political one, with the remedy given as preaching righteousness and holiness from the pulpit.
quote: it was a moral issue
falsify_match: Not applicable; a diagnosis rather than a prediction.
falsify_miss: Not applicable.

claim_text: The glory coming into the churches so that people stop sleeping around, on the Welsh revival pattern where the bars shut down, with a shaking in the pulpits and a major revival about to take place, and then Cuba seen with the day of deliverance come and horns heard.
quote: the bars shut down the things things changed
falsify_match: A measurable moral change in American churches alongside a Cuban opening.
falsify_miss: Neither. The Welsh comparison sets a historical benchmark that would be visible if met.

claim_text: The same passage repeated, with the shaking in the pulpits and the day of deliverance for Cuba and the horns.
quote: This is the day of of basically deliverance
falsify_match: As above.
falsify_miss: As above; repetition within the stream.

claim_text: Horns blowing across Cuba three times as a blast, with a great revival coming to Cuba, Venezuela, Colombia and Brazil, and the day of deliverance proclaimed for the Latino community.
quote: A great revival is coming to Cuba, to Venezuela, to Colombia
falsify_match: A religious movement across the four named countries.
falsify_miss: No such movement. Latin American Protestant growth has been continuous for decades, which is the base rate to beat.

claim_text: The day of breakthrough declared for Cuba and Colombia with a proclamation like the one to the children of Israel, and excitement extended to Africa, Asia and Europe, followed by a demonic play at Coachella with snakes rising up to cause major disruptions, and prayer over Boston, the marathon, the Red Cross and the 20th.
quote: It's time. The day of the breakthrough is here
falsify_match: An incident at Coachella or the Boston Marathon around 18 to 20 April 2026.
falsify_miss: Both passed without incident, which he later credits to prayer.

claim_text: A snake rising up at Coachella with writing seen, which he compares to the Astroworld crush in Houston in November where the atmosphere shifted and people were trampled, and says it is the same kind of spirit over the concert.
quote: It's the same kind of spirit over the concert
falsify_match: A crowd crush or comparable disaster at Coachella.
falsify_miss: None occurred. The Astroworld comparison sets the benchmark for what would have counted.

claim_text: The 18th named again with prayer for Coachella and for events across America, and the Red Cross reinterpreted as being about hospitals rather than the race, with the NBA playoffs starting on the 18th and Boston and New York named specifically.
quote: pray for the NBA playoffs, specifically Boston and New York
falsify_match: An incident at an NBA playoff game in Boston or New York on or after 18 April 2026.
falsify_miss: No incident. Naming the competition, the date and two cities makes this the most specific security warning of the batch.

claim_text: The NBA playoffs and the hospitals repeated, with the material presented as pieces put together by the leading of the Spirit rather than coincidence.
quote: this is not coincidence
falsify_match: As above.
falsify_miss: As above. The assembling of separate items into one pattern is the method on display here.

claim_text: A California bill proposing a ten thousand dollar fine for exposing corruption, and Gavin Newsom seen as a snake slithering on his belly and licking the ground with a blue cape and a mask, trying to reach the White House in the days ahead.
quote: I see he's licking the ground like a serpent
falsify_match: Newsom running for and reaching the presidency.
falsify_miss: He does not. The licking the ground image was given of a Black senator in an earlier telling and is attached to Newsom here, which is a change of the named person.
